mode.description: RFdiffusion workflow mode. `unconditional` (default) generates de novo backbones; `binder_design` builds binders against `target_pdb`; `motif_scaffolding` builds scaffolds around fixed motif residues; `partial_diffusion` re-noises an existing structure; `fold_conditioning` requires a `scaffold_dir`; `symmetric_*` modes enforce point-group symmetry via `symmetry`.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. When provided, auto-promotes mode to `partial_diffusion` and uses the first item's structure_path as the seed structure.

profile_guidance.description: Family-profile guidance compiled from a profile_source upstream. For unconditional/symmetric modes, length defaults may be derived from profile length statistics when no explicit length fields are set; motif evidence remains advisory unless structure-mapped constraints are provided separately.

target_pdb.description: Target structure (.pdb) for binder/motif modes. Null is valid for `unconditional`.

target_chain.description: Single-letter chain id on `target_pdb` to bind against / scaffold from.

target_residues.description: Inclusive integer range `<start>-<end>` of target residues. FASTA/sequence 1-indexed when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy structure residue range.

target_hotspots.description: Hotspot residues. Integer values are FASTA/sequence 1-indexed when a target sequence is provided; string values such as `A10` are explicit structure residue IDs.

target_hotspot_residue_ids.description: Explicit hotspot residue identifiers `<chain><resnum>[icode]`. Useful when target residue numbering is non-standard.

target_sequence.description: Full FASTA/sequence for target_residues and integer target_hotspots sequence-to-structure mapping.

target_fasta_path.description: FASTA file for target_residues and integer target_hotspots sequence-to-structure mapping. Alternative to inline `target_sequence`.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer position inputs. `auto` picks sequence when a target sequence is provided, else structure; `sequence` forces 1-indexed FASTA positions; `structure` forces legacy PDB residue numbering.

contigs.description: Raw RFdiffusion-native contig syntax. Prefer `target_residues` for sequence-indexed target ranges; use this only for advanced multi-chain contig wiring.

length_min.description: Minimum total scaffold length (residues) for unconditional/motif modes.

length_max.description: Maximum total scaffold length. Null pins to `length_min` for a fixed-size sampling.

total_length.description: Fixed total oligomer/scaffold length. Overrides `length_min`/`length_max` when set (used by symmetric and motif modes).

binder_length_min.description: Minimum binder length (residues) for binder modes.

binder_length_max.description: Maximum binder length. Null pins to `binder_length_min`.

symmetry.description: Point-group symmetry tag (e.g. `C3`, `D4`, `T`, `O`, `I`). Required for `symmetric_*` modes.

num_diffusion_steps.description: Diffusion timesteps. 50 is the recommended default; lower for speed, higher for quality.

partial_T.description: Partial-diffusion timestep count. Required for `partial_diffusion` mode (number of forward-noise steps to apply before re-denoising).

noise_scale_ca.description: CA-translational noise scale during sampling. Lower yields tighter, less-diverse backbones.

noise_scale_frame.description: Backbone-frame rotational noise scale during sampling.

inpaint_seq.description: RFdiffusion `inpaint_seq` selectors (fixed sequence regions). Simple integer/range selectors are sequence-mapped when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; complex selectors remain native syntax.

inpaint_str.description: RFdiffusion `inpaint_str` selectors (fixed structure regions). Same mapping behavior as `inpaint_seq`.

provide_seq.description: RFdiffusion `provide_seq` selectors (sequence-known regions). Same mapping behavior as `inpaint_seq`.

contig_length.description: Contig length range `<min>-<max>` used by some advanced motif modes.

checkpoint_path.description: Optional override path to a specific RFdiffusion checkpoint (.pt). Null uses the env-configured default.

model_directory_path.description: Optional override directory containing RFdiffusion weights. Null uses the env-configured default.

scaffold_dir.description: Directory of secondary-structure/adjacency scaffolds for `fold_conditioning` mode.

target_ss.description: Path to a target secondary-structure file used by fold conditioning.

target_adj.description: Path to a target adjacency-matrix file used by fold conditioning.

guiding_potentials.description: Names of RFdiffusion guiding-potential terms (e.g. `monomer_ROG`, `binder_ROG`). Null disables guidance.

guide_scale.description: Strength of the guiding-potential applied during sampling. Null disables.

guide_decay.description: Decay schedule of the guiding potential across diffusion steps.

olig_intra_all.description: Symmetric-oligomer flag: enforce intra-chain symmetry across all chains. Null preserves upstream default.

olig_inter_all.description: Symmetric-oligomer flag: enforce inter-chain symmetry across all chains. Null preserves upstream default.

hydra_overrides.description: Raw Hydra config overrides forwarded to RFdiffusion (`key=value` strings). Reserved for power users; most workflows do not need this.

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed for reproducibility.
